name: convo_v3_chat_turn
description: v3: one chat turn that can do real work. Memory from the previous execution (v1), then an LLM router (JSON output) + Switch decides whether to run the convo_v3_get_portfolio Sub Workflow (HTTP lookup) before answering.

inputTemplate.systemPrompt: You are a wealth advisor assistant. Be concise.

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.prev | if type == "object" then (.response.body? // .workflow? // .) else null end) as $p | (($p | type) == "object" and $p.status == "COMPLETED" and $p.correlationId == .sid and ($p.output.history? | type) == "array") as $ok | (if $ok then $p.output.history else [] end) as $h | {restored: $ok, history: $h, routerText: ((($h[-4:]) | map(.role + ": " + .message) | join("\n")) + "\nLATEST user message: " + .message)}

(.r | if type == "string" then (try fromjson catch {}) else . end | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $r | ($r.clientName | if type == "string" then (split(" ") | map(select(length > 0)) | join(" ")) else "" end) as $n | (.text | ascii_downcase) as $t | ($r.intent == "portfolio" and ($n | length) > 0 and ($t | contains($n | split(" ") | last | ascii_downcase))) as $go | {intent: (if $go then "portfolio" else "chat" end), clientName: (if $go then $n else null end)}

(if (.lk | type) == "object" then .lk else null end) as $lk | (if $lk == null then null else {clientName: .clientName, found: ($lk.found == true), error: $lk.error, subWorkflowId: $lk.subWorkflowId, totalValue: ($lk.portfolio.totalValue? // null)} end) as $sum | (if $lk == null then "" else "

LOOKUP RESULT (use these exact numbers; say if not found/unavailable): " + ({found: ($lk.found == true), error: $lk.error, portfolio: $lk.portfolio} | tojson) + (if $lk.error then "
The portfolio service is temporarily unavailable: tell the user the data is temporarily unavailable and to try again later. Do not invent numbers." elif ($lk.found == true) then "
Answer with the client total value written in full with commas (e.g. $1,250,000), the YTD return and the main holdings." else "
The client was not found: tell the user that " + .clientName + " was not found and list the known clients from portfolio.known." end) end) as $extra | {lookup: $sum, messages: ([{role: "system", message: (.sys + $extra)}] + (.history // []) + [{role: "user", message: .message}])}
((.history // []) + [{role: "user", message: .message}, {role: "assistant", message: (.reply | tostring)}]) as $h | {history: (if ($h | length) > 20 then $h[-20:] else $h end)}
